items.headline: Broadcom reported Q2 FY26 revenue of $22.2 billion, up 48% year over year, and guided Q3 revenue to about $29.4 billion, up 84% year over year.
Broadcom launched cash tender offers to buy back up to $2.5 billion of selected outstanding senior notes.
Broadcom and Samsung unveiled an integrated 5G + Wi‑Fi 8 fixed wireless access platform, expanding its product roadmap in edge connectivity.
Broadcom and LSEG renewed their technology partnership with a new five-year agreement focused on VMware Cloud Foundation 9.
